header.description: What: Simulated devices SD-S2c (DESIGN_Simulated_Devices §3.13c D-104 / D-110). A scripted trainee possesses the Operator, binds his view to the drone ground station he carries and works it: POWER (the drone answers), ARM, TAKEOFF (the recon drone beside him climbs to its 15 m hover); then the RIGHT STICK forward at half (axis 3 = 0.5, Mode 2 pitch) for 13.3 s flies it 200 m north, and LAND brings it down. The drone is flown THROUGH the station - the station writes its command on itself (RemoteControl), the drone's own brain (RemotePilot) reads it - never possessed. Judge: (1) the station's mode (its DroneStationState memory) follows OFF -> LINKED -> ARMED -> FLYING -> LANDED; (2) the drone is above 8 m while it flies; (3) it lands within 30 m of the point 200 m north of its launch, and is down (FlightState.Airborne 0) at the end; (4) its battery drained (DroneBattery below full) and its link held (DroneLink never lost while flown). Fail: a press does nothing, the drone flies on its own, or lands elsewhere. Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh dv-drone-fly
